notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet T1-SA113: HEAVY / VEHICLE / DETOUR 100 B between two changeable direction-arrow plates (200 x 200, R5); drawn with both arrows pointing ahead as the sheet shows — the plates turn to point left or right on site. Layout: 900 x 600, yellow, R0, black border 15, no edge strip. Legend placed from the sheet's own filled artwork measured at 1200 dpi (letter heights from the ink, series confirmed by the FHWA widths, each word centred on its ink; the sheet's dimension chains were not transcribed one by one for this sign — the positions are the sheet's drawn artwork itself, which the overlay check confirms): HEAVY 100 B top 85 x 311-589 (278); VEHICLE 100 B top 250 x 267-631 (364); DETOUR 100 B top 415 x 285-616 (331); symbol two changeable arrow plates (200 square, A:100 up arrows as drawn) with their outlines x 34-880 y 215-402.
